create_dp_sgd_server: create a SyncDPSGDServer instance with a global IFLModel and optional communication channel for DP-SGD federated learning
select_clients_for_training: select clients for training by calling select_clients_for_training with num_total_users and users_per_round to get user indices
init_round: initialize a training round by calling init_round to zero aggregator weights, reset optimizer gradients, and reset clipper stats
receive_update_from_client: receive a client update by calling receive_update_from_client with a Message containing the model delta and weight
step_aggregate_and_optimize: perform a training step by calling step to aggregate updates, add Gaussian noise, and update the global model optimizer
